temp_grade.grade_label: Commercial (0°C to +125°C TJ; use NCP1117IST33T3G for -40°C)

exposed_pad.note: SOT-223 heatsink tab (Pin 4) is internally connected to Pin 2 (Output / VOUT); do NOT tie tab to GND (p.1).

pinout.description: Regulated 3.3 V output, internally connected to the SOT-223 thermal tab; requires >= 4.7 uF cap with 0.033–2.2 ohm ESR.

vin_abs_max_v.condition: Maximum Ratings Input Voltage = 20 V (Note 3: Iout must not exceed 1.0 A when Vin > 12 V, p.2)

vin_min_v.condition: NCP1117-3.3 minimum input voltage for output regulation tests (4.75 V <= Vin <= 15 V, p.3)

vin_max_v.condition: NCP1117-3.3 line regulation and quiescent current maximum specified input voltage (series operates up to 20 V with Iout <= 1.0 A above 12 V, p.1-4)

vout_v.condition: Fixed 3.3 V output option (NCP1117ST33T3G Active in Ordering Information, p.12)

vout_tolerance_pct.condition: 3.267 V to 3.333 V (±1.0%) at TA = 25°C, Vin = 5.3 V, Iout = 10 mA; widens to 3.235 V to 3.365 V (±2.0%) over 0°C to +125°C (p.3)

iout_max_ma.condition: Output current in excess of 1.0 A (1.0 A min / 1.5 A typ / 2.2 A max current limit; dropout specified at 800 mA, p.1 & p.3)

iq_typ_ua.condition: NCP1117-3.3 quiescent current 6.0 mA typ (10 mA max) at Vin = 15 V (p.4)

dropout_typ_mv.condition: 1.07 V typ (1.20 V max) at Iout = 800 mA, ΔVout = 1% (0.95 V typ at 100 mA, 1.03 V typ at 500 mA, p.3)

psrr_db.condition: NCP1117-3.3 ripple rejection 64 dB typ (60 dB min) at f = 120 Hz, Vin - Vout = 6.4 V, Iout = 500 mA, Cout = 10 uF (p.4)

output_noise_uvrms.condition: 0.003% of Vout = 99 uVRMS (10 Hz to 10 kHz, TA = 25°C, p.4)

min_cout_uf.condition: Output Capacitor section (p.9): minimum 4.7 uF tantalum/electrolytic with ESR between 33 mOhm and 2.2 ohm

esr_min_ohm.condition: 33 mOhm (0.033 ohm) typical minimum ESR floor at 4.7 uF (Fig. 12-13 p.6 & text p.9; drops to ~20 mOhm at 10 uF)

esr_max_ohm.condition: 2.2 ohm maximum ESR ceiling across full load and temperature range (p.9)

design_gotchas.title: Commercial 0°C to +125°C Grade Only — Missing 'I' Prefix Excludes Sub-Zero Operation
design_gotchas.detail: NCP1117ST33T3G (without 'I') is rated strictly 0°C to +125°C TJ (p.2, p.4 Note 4, p.12). For -40°C to +125°C industrial designs, order the industrial variant NCP1117IST33T3G or evaluate LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB.

design_gotchas.title: 33 mOhm Minimum ESR Floor Places Standard 4.7–10 uF MLCCs in Unstable Region
design_gotchas.detail: 300 DPI Vision inspection of Figure 12–13 (p.6) and Applications text (p.9) confirms a 33 mOhm typical minimum ESR boundary (~20 mOhm at 10 uF) up to 2.2 ohm max. Standard 4.7–10 uF MLCCs (< 10 mOhm ESR) fall into the Region of Instability unless >= 47 uF ceramic or a small series resistor is added.

design_gotchas.title: High 160°C/W Minimum-Pad RθJA & 1.0 A Current Cap Above 12 V Input
design_gotchas.detail: CASE 318H SOT-223 exhibits 160°C/W on a minimum pad (p.2), dropping to ~65°C/W only with a 30 mm square 2 oz copper heatsink connected to the VOUT tab (Fig. 21, p.8). Note 3 (p.2) also limits output current to <= 1.0 A whenever Vin > 12 V.

design_gotchas.title: External Protection Diode Required if Cout > 50 uF & Input Can Be Crowbarred
design_gotchas.detail: Page 10 warns that although the internal output-to-input path survives ~15 A for 100 us, designs using Cout > 50 uF where Vin can be abruptly shorted to ground should add an external protection diode across Vout-to-Vin.

typical_use_cases: Commercial (0°C–125°C) 5 V-to-3.3 V up-to-1 A linear rails with lower dropout (1.07 V typ) than LM1117
Consumer set-top boxes, networking gear, and active bus termination on standard 1117 SOT-223 footprints
Higher-current (1.0 A min limit) candidate drop-in for AMS1117-3.3 with 20 V max VIN margin
12 V-to-3.3 V moderate-current supplies utilizing tantalum or polymer-tantalum COUT (33 mOhm–2.2 ohm ESR)
engineering_summary: The onsemi NCP1117ST33T3G is a commercial-grade (0°C to +125°C) 1.0 A SOT-223-3 (CASE 318H) linear regulator with standard 1117 pinout (1=GND, 2/Tab=VOUT, 3=VIN), 20 V absolute maximum input rating, and slightly lower dropout (1.07 V typ / 1.20 V max at 800 mA) than LM1117. It is a strong candidate drop-in for 1117 SOT-223 footprints in indoor systems, but engineers must verify its 0°C minimum temperature limit (use NCP1117IST33T3G for -40°C), 33 mOhm–2.2 ohm ESR window (not direct 4.7–10 uF MLCC-stable), and 160°C/W minimum-pad thermal resistance before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.1 confirmed SOT-223 (CASE 318H) Top View pinout (1=Adjust/Ground, 2=Output, 3=Input) and heatsink tab connected to Pin 2 (VOUT).
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.2 confirmed Vin max=20 V (Note 3: <=1 A above 12 V), commercial TJ=0 to 125°C, θJA=160°C/W min pad, θJC=15°C/W.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.6 (Fig. 12-13) confirmed Region of Instability below ~20-33 mOhm ESR, matching p.9 text (4.7 uF min, 0.033-2.2 ohm ESR).
